## 1. Configure the source and recovery ledger
Read approved request rows, related records and saved outcomes. One request is rendered per execution; run each workflow serially.

## 2. Verify career source records
Football editors need sourced career stories without mixing statistics from different seasons.

## 3. Reconcile loans and breakthrough statistics
Private career video, fact trail, competition-total reconciliation and an approved narration handoff.

parameters.content:
## 4. Freeze the decision and recover paid work
Freeze the business decision and finished design. Recover accepted jobs and completed deliveries. Changed revisions and unknown paid outcomes require reconciliation.

nodes.name: 5. Validate the designed video and credit ceiling

parameters.content:
## 5. Validate the designed video and credit ceiling
Native Zvid validation checks the project and quote. Preview returns resolved JSON and the quote without rendering or writing tracking rows.

nodes.name: 6. Submit once and retain the accepted job

parameters.content:
## 6. Submit once and retain the accepted job
Persist intent before the paid request. Uncertain outcomes stop. Explicit HTTP 429 rejections allow at most two manual retries after cooldown. Save accepted jobs and completed media for recovery.

## 7. Retain rejected or uncertain submissions
Capture only structured HTTP evidence. A definite 429 stores a minimum 30-second cooldown and bounded manual retry count. Unknown failures remain ambiguous; inspect the saved job before retrying.

## 8. Deliver the video privately
Check deterministic filenames and content hashes before uploading. Preserve completed video URLs when download or delivery fails. No public-sharing action is configured.

nodes.name: 9. Verify the source and record the handoff

parameters.content:
## 9. Verify the source and record the handoff
Recheck approval, revision and content before writing output columns. Read the receipt back before marking the delivery complete.

nodes.name: 10. Review the decision report and video

parameters.content:
## 10. Review the decision report and video
The output includes business decisions and review artifacts as downloadable JSON. Watch video → Binary → data → View plays completed media; failed previews retain the delivered video URL.

## Turn verified player milestones into a career story

### How it works
Football editors need sourced career stories without mixing statistics from different seasons. Private career video, fact trail, competition-total reconciliation and an approved narration handoff. Three named domain stages qualify the source, calculate the business decision and prepare the approved design. The output includes a private video, decision report and a verified source receipt. Saved snapshots recover accepted jobs without paying for a duplicate. Review cases return reasons and draft artifacts.

### Setup
1. Install **`@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid`** from **Settings → Community nodes** before Zvid credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
2. Create **Zvid API** credentials at https://app.zvid.io/api-keys, Base URL `https://api.zvid.io`; assign them to all Zvid nodes. Connect Google Sheets and Google Drive OAuth2.
3. Configure the workbook, Requests/Records tabs and private Drive folder in **Config**. Requests require source_id, revision, approval and brief_json; Records require parent_id, revision, kind, record_id and data_json. Use the companion `studio-football-career-turning-point.md` and sample JSON.
4. **dryRun: false renders and spends credits** within maxRenderCredits. True returns validated JSON and a quote, not an editor draft. Run serially; reconcile ambiguous submissions.
5. Inspect **Decision report file** and **Watch video → Binary → data → View** before enabling the schedule.

[Zvid setup reference](https://docs.zvid.io). Support: https://zvid.io/contact
